m.s: Finely grate {onion} and squeeze out the juice. Mix with {lamb_mince}, crushed {garlic}, {cumin}, {cinnamon}, chopped {parsley*0.5} and 1 tsp salt. Mix well with your hands for a minute so it binds.
Shape into small sausages, about three per serve, and press them onto skewers if you have them. Chill for 15 minutes so they hold together on the grill.
Finely dice {cucumber}, {cherrytom} and {red_onion}. Toss with the rest of the parsley, the juice of {lemon}, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt.

Heat a grill pan, BBQ or frying pan over medium-high heat with a little oil. Cook the kofta for 8 to 10 minutes, turning every couple of minutes, until charred and cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Warm {pita} in the oven or a dry pan for 1 minute so it's soft and pliable.
Spread {hummus} over each plate and add the kofta, salad and a spoonful of {yoghurt}, with the bread on the side for scooping.

l: Kofta, salad and hummus in one container, bread on the side. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF wraps instead of flatbread. Check the hummus label.
